args.subject: Private Dining Table Request for 12 – Friday, May 24, 2024
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to request a table for 12 guests at your private dining room on Friday, May 24, 2024.

We would ideally be seated in the evening, around 7:00 PM, though we would also be happy to be accommodated during your lunch service if that is more suitable for a private event. Please let us know which time slots are available and whether any minimum spend or deposit applies for a party of 12.

If you require any further details, such as menu preferences or dietary requirements, please do not hesitate to ask.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923

Thank you, and we look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
